title: Project Manager
jobDescription: About Us We are a dynamic team of young engineers, domain experts, and seasoned sales professionals dedicated to providing comprehensive turnkey solutions for complex challenges in Signal Processing. Our expertise spans the cutting-edge technologies in Signal Processing, addressing critical needs in the Defence and Aerospace sectors. Our offerings encompass a wide range of solutions, from tactical radios and radar systems to extensive research and mission-critical applications. About the role The Project Manager will be responsible for planning, executing, and delivering projects within the Radar, EW & Communications department. Based in Hyderabad or Bangalore, this role will work closely with the VP – Technical Director to manage cross-functional teams comprising Product Leads, Developers, and Subject Matter Experts (SMEs). The Project Manager will ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and aligned with technical and business objectives. This role requires strong coordination, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills, along with the ability to lead teams of 4–12 members and drive successful project outcomes in a dynamic, technology-driven environment

title: Senior RF & Microwave Hardware Engineer
jobDescription: About Us We are a group of young and enthusiastic engineers, domain experts providing turnkey solutions to challenging requirements in Signal Processing. We work on leading technologies in Signal Processing solving problems in Defence and Aerospace fields. Our solutions range from tactical radios to radars, and from research to mission critical applications. About the role As a Senior RF Hardware Design Engineer, you will play a key role in the architecture, design, simulation, implementation, bring-up, and verification of RF and microwave hardware subsystems for aerospace and defence applications. The role includes RF signal-chain design from antenna port to baseband, including LNAs, PAs, mixers, filters, RF switches, attenuators, PLLs, frequency synthesizers, clock/LO distribution, and wideband RF front-end modules operating up to 40 GHz. The engineer will translate system-level requirements into circuit-level specifications and support the complete hardware development cycle from concept to qualification and production support.

title: Sr. DSP Algorithm Engineer
jobDescription: About Us We are a dynamic team of engineers, researchers, and domain experts who build advanced signal processing solutions for Defence, Aerospace, and Research applications . Our work spans high-performance communication systems, Telemetry Receivers, Radar Processing, and mission-critical signal processing platforms. We focus on solving complex real-world problems by developing state-of-the-art DSP algorithms and high-performance implementations for RF, FPGA, Embedded Processors, and high-speed computing platforms. About the role We are looking for a Sr. Algorithm Developer – DSP who can design, analyze, and implement advanced signal processing algorithms from first principles. This role requires strong theoretical foundations in DSP and communications, along with the ability to translate research literature (IEEE papers, standards, and technical publications) into working algorithms and optimized implementations. The role also involves studying existing algorithms and improving their performance, robustness, and computational efficiency for real-world deployment. The candidate will work on communication and radar signal processing algorithms including modulators, demodulators, synchronization techniques, channel coding, detection, estimation, and performance optimization.
